info.title: API.SH: Madlan
info.description: The Madlan API from API.SH: public Madlan data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

A city, neighbourhood, street or address: names, hierarchy, coordinates, description, nearby neighbourhoods, average price per m² and deals in the last year, building facts for an address; for a neighbourhood also deal counts and their trend, average price per m² and its trend, average building year, 5- and 10-year price change and rent yield; plus the site's area notes (residents and demographics, apartment sizes, new building work, schools, noise, parking, planning and more, as the site writes them, in Hebrew).

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/madlan-autocomplete

get.description:
One home or commercial listing with everything the listing page shows: price, price history, rooms, bathrooms, size, balcony, floor, building year, condition, parking, air directions, availability, city tax and building fee, full description, every photo and floor plan, amenities, nearby park, rail station and school, investment yield, the agent and office (private sellers with the name and photo the listing shows; their phone and email are left out) and `raw`. `latest=true` returns the newest listing of `location` (Tel Aviv-Yafo when no location is given).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/madlan-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing id (e.g. `9j9zLuB9xcT`) or its madlan.co.il/listings link.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: With `location` and no `id`: the newest listing of that place.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: With `latest=true`: the place to take the newest listing from (same forms as in search); default Tel Aviv-Yafo.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Asking prices, rents, price per m² and yields for a place, its city and Israel, by room count (1-10, duplex, penthouse, garden apartment, single family, all) and by new or second-hand homes, with the price history since 2011 and the site's forecast; plus the site's older price table by rooms.

get.description:
Homes or commercial properties for sale or rent in an Israeli city, neighbourhood, street or address, with every filter of the site: price, rooms, bathrooms, floor, size, price per m², monthly city tax, property type, condition, seller (agent, private owner, developer), amenities, safe room, no agent fee, price drops, below the site's price estimate, immediate entry and listed within N days. Each listing: id, address with place ids, coordinates, price, rooms, size, floor, property type, condition, price history, photos, amenities, the agent or office (private sellers with the name and photo the listing shows; their phone and email are left out), investment yield and `raw`. `total` is the site's match count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/madlan-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A place: its Hebrew name (`חיפה`, `רמת אביב`), a place id from `/madlan/v1/autocomplete` (`שכונה-רמת-התשבי-חיפה-ישראל`) or a madlan.co.il search or area link.

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated. Homes: flat, gardenApartment, penthouse, penthouseApp, miniPenthouse, roofFlat, duplex, triplex, cottage, dualCottage, serialCottage, villa, studio, attic, basement, splitFlat, residentialUnit, building, land, agricultureLand, agricultureFarm, professionalFarm, vacationProperty, parking, storeroom, other. Commercial: office, shop, hall, clinic, hotel, restaurant, sharedWorkSpace, parkingLot, industrialBuilding, incomeProducingProperty, farmLand, lab, storeroom, building, land, agricultureLand, other.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Comma-separated: new, asNew, fine, renovated, preserved, toRenovated, requiresRenovation, finish, fullFinish, furnishedFinish, skin.

parameters.name: amenities
parameters.description: Comma-separated. Homes: accessible, airConditioner, attic, balcony, basement, buildingLaundry, ceilingFan, dishwasher, doorman, elevator, fireplace, furnished, garage, grating, gym, heating, outdoorSpace, parking, pool, roofdeck, secureRoom, storage, unitLaundry, unitPetsAllowed.

parameters.name: safe_room
parameters.description: Comma-separated: secureRoom (in-flat safe room), mamak (floor safe room), miklat (shelter).

parameters.name: quality_class
parameters.description: Commercial only, comma-separated building classes: A, B, C, D.

parameters.name: min_employees
parameters.description: Commercial only: minimum number of workstations.

parameters.name: no_fee
parameters.description: Only listings without an agent fee.

parameters.name: below_estimate
parameters.description: Only listings priced below the site's estimate.

parameters.name: listed_within_days
parameters.description: Only listings first seen in the last N days (1-365).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Agents and offices in the site's yearly agent ranking (Madad) for a city or neighbourhood: ranking category, sales, exclusive listings, office, business phone and photo.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/madlan-top-agents

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A place: its Hebrew name (`חיפה`, `רמת אביב`), a place id from `/madlan/v1/autocomplete` (`שכונה-רמת-התשבי-חיפה-ישראל`) or a madlan.co.il search or area link.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Ranking year (2018 to this year); default the latest.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
